name: @normwerk/einvoice-e2e
description: End-to-end suite on docker compose — a real Medusa v2 app, the plugin packages installed from a local Verdaccio registry (not workspace-linked), driven through the real Admin/Store HTTP APIs. Proves wiring (a real order's data reaches the plugin and comes back out correctly), not tax semantics (packages/einvoice-medusa/fixtures/tax-matrix already owns that).
